name: Cock-A-Doodle-Doo
description: The most popular food stop at Walibi Netherlands — Cock-A-Doodle-Doo is a fun and lively chicken restaurant in the Wilderness area serving crispy fried chicken, chicken burgers, wraps and sides that consistently attract the longest lunchtime queues in the park. The quality is notably above standard theme park chicken fare and the fun barnyard atmosphere makes it one of the most enjoyable and talked-about dining stops in the Dutch theme park scene.

items.description: Crispy fried chicken pieces with fries and dipping sauce

items.name: Chicken Burger
items.description: Crispy chicken fillet burger with lettuce and sauce

items.description: Grilled chicken wrap with salad and sauce

items.description: Small chicken nuggets with fries and drink

name: La Hacienda
description: A vibrant Mexican-themed restaurant serving burritos, tacos, nachos and quesadillas in a colourful hacienda setting with outdoor terrace seating. La Hacienda is one of the most distinctively flavoured food options at Walibi Netherlands and particularly popular with older visitors and young adults who appreciate Mexican street food flavours rather than standard theme park burger fare. The outdoor terrace is a pleasant spot for lunch on a warm day.

items.name: Burrito
items.description: Large flour tortilla filled with chicken or beef, rice, beans and salsa

items.name: Nachos
items.description: Tortilla chips with cheese sauce, guacamole and salsa

items.name: Taco Box
items.description: Three tacos with your choice of filling and toppings

items.name: Mexican Beer
items.description: Cold Mexican beer or non-alcoholic alternative

name: Flavors
description: A diverse street food concept at the heart of the Festivalization theme — Flavors brings together international street food flavours including Asian noodles, Mediterranean wraps and Dutch snacks in a lively outdoor food court atmosphere that perfectly captures the festival spirit of Walibi Netherlands. One of the most interesting and varied dining options in the park.

items.name: Noodle Box
items.description: Stir-fried noodles with vegetables and choice of protein

items.name: Falafel Wrap

name: Doner Kebab
description: A popular quick-service Turkish grill stand serving freshly sliced doner kebab in pita or as a platter alongside fries, salad and sauces. The Doner Kebab stand is one of the most generously portioned and consistently satisfying food options at Walibi Netherlands — particularly popular with hungry teenagers and young adults who need substantial fuel between the park's thrill rides.

items.description: Freshly sliced doner kebab in warm pita with salad and sauce

items.name: Doner Platter
items.description: Generous doner kebab with fries and salad

name: Toast N Wrap
description: A convenient quick-service sandwich and wrap outlet serving freshly made toasted sandwiches, wraps and light bites throughout the day — a reliable option for visitors wanting something lighter than a full meal between rides. Toast N Wrap is one of the most accessible and family-friendly food stops in the park with a wide selection of fillings to suit different tastes.
